definitions.map_target: mean interaction squared over contexts and four covers
definitions.predictor_freeze: all confirmation predictor maps and ranked supports use discovery values with no confirmation calibration
definitions.query_efficiency: singleton outer support rankings need only endpoint effects; their reported map R2 scale uses one alpha fitted on the full discovery map. Row/column, SVD, and raw support rankings require the full pair atlas
definitions.residual_analysis: descriptive split-local nuisance removal; discovery absolute-residual support is evaluated on squared confirmation residual

rank1_svd.construction: leading rank-one SVD term of the energy map

row_column_outer.construction: outer product of row/column energy totals divided by total

singleton_effect_outer.construction: outer product of mean-squared singleton effects; one no-intercept least-squares scalar fitted within this split

endpoint_singleton_outer.construction: outer product of signed mean singleton effects with one no-intercept scalar fitted on discovery

rank1_svd_signed_map.construction: leading rank-one SVD term of discovery signed map
